Kit summary

Dawnstrike FlurryActive
Attacks a single enemy twice, each hit dealing HP Burning DMG equal to 3.0% of Valkyrie's Max HP. The second hit inflicts 1 layer of HP Burning for 2 turns.
Starpiercer Lv.3DMG dealt to Bosses is increased to 1000% with 5 HP Burning allies deployed.
Heavenly Feather BarrageActive
Attacks all enemies, dealing HP Burning DMG equal to 3.0% of Valkyrie's Max HP. With 3 or more layers of Battle Will: Divine Might, deals an additional instance of the same DMG.
Starpiercer Lv.1After actively casting it, Valkyrie casts Dawnstrike Flurry once. When it hits a non-Boss unit, Valkyrie and the highest-ATK ally gain 10% Turn Meter (up to 2 times before her next action). Each cast increases all allies' Skill DMG by 40%.
Starpiercer Lv.3DMG dealt to Bosses is increased to 1000% with 5 HP Burning allies deployed.
War Song of the EinherjarPassive
When another ally pursues and attacks with a basic attack, gains 1 layer of Battle Will: Edge (+10.0% Basic Attack DMG per layer, max 5). When another ally pursues with a skill, gains 1 layer of Battle Will: Divine Might (increases Heavenly Feather Barrage and Divine Advent: Judgment DMG by 0.4% of her Max HP per layer, max 5); up to 2 times per unit turn. Using Dawnstrike Flurry with Edge pursues once with it and consumes all Edge layers. Using Divine Advent: Judgment with Divine Might pursues once with Heavenly Feather Barrage and consumes all Divine Might layers.
Starpiercer Lv.2Valkyrie's own basic-attack pursuits give 1 layer of Edge and skill pursuits give 1 layer of Divine Might. At 5 layers of Divine Might, pursues with Divine Advent: Judgment once instead, reducing all enemies' DMG dealt by 50% for 2 turns, then consumes all layers. With 5 Pursue & Attack allies deployed, pursues with Heavenly Feather Barrage after another ally casts a skill (once before her next action).
Starpiercer Lv.3With 5 Pursue & Attack allies deployed, at the start of each wave reduces all enemies' Turn Meter by 40% and gains 100% Turn Meter. At 5 layers of Divine Might, immediately casts Divine Advent: Judgment once (not a pursuit).
Divine Advent: JudgmentActive
Grants all allies HP Up II for 2 turns. Inflicts Judgment Brand on all enemies for 2 turns (records DMG taken; at the start of each turn deals 50% of the recorded amount as DMG, then clears it). Then attacks all enemies 3 times, each hit dealing HP Burning DMG equal to 5.0% of Valkyrie's Max HP.
Starpiercer Lv.1Each cast increases all allies' Skill DMG by 40%; hits on non-Boss units also give Turn Meter (see Heavenly Feather Barrage).
Starpiercer Lv.3Judgment Brand deals 80% of the recorded amount. Casting it at 5 Divine Might layers inflicts Divine Edict on all enemies (+15% Skill DMG taken, -15% Skill DMG dealt, max 4 layers) and gives all allies 2 layers of Sacred Wing Aegis (DoT immunity, lose 1 layer per turn end, max 4). With 5 HP Burning allies deployed, Boss DMG is increased to 1000%; when an active cast hits a Boss, all allies pursue with a basic attack once and its CD is reduced by 1 turn.
Starpiercer (Exclusive) levels are shown under each skill they change.
